tools.name: studio_status
tools.title: Studio status
tools.description: Connects to NCWE Studio (starting it if needed) and reports the game, the project, the camera, the selection and streaming. Call it first.

tools.name: set_camera
tools.title: Move the camera
tools.description: Moves the editor camera (and with it what is loaded around it). Use look_at to aim at a point, frame_ids to frame objects, bookmark for a saved view. wait (default true) waits until the area has streamed in.

position.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

look_at.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

heading.description: View direction in degrees (0 = looking along +Y, 90 = along -X)

pitch.description: Degrees, negative looks down (-90 straight down)

distance.description: With look_at and no position: distance from the target (default 12 m)

bookmark.description: Name of one of the user's bookmarks

fov.description: Field of view in degrees across the shorter image side, 10-120 (default 45; 70-90 shows a whole room from inside). It stays until changed: it is the user's view too.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot
tools.description: Renders the 3D view and returns it as an image (after waiting for streaming). Optional camera arguments move the camera first. labels:true numbers your project objects in the image (the reply maps numbers to ids); label_ids numbers chosen objects.

position.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

look_at.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

heading.description: View direction in degrees (0 = looking along +Y, 90 = along -X)

pitch.description: Degrees, negative looks down (-90 straight down)

distance.description: With look_at and no position: distance from the target (default 12 m)

bookmark.description: Name of one of the user's bookmarks

fov.description: Field of view in degrees across the shorter image side, 10-120 (default 45; 70-90 shows a whole room from inside). It stays until changed: it is the user's view too.

tools.name: wait_for_streaming
tools.title: Wait for streaming
tools.description: Waits until the sectors and meshes around the camera are loaded.

tools.name: pick_screen_point
tools.title: What is at a pixel
tools.description: Tells which object (and which 3D point) is under a pixel of the last screenshot.

tools.name: raycast
tools.title: Ray cast
tools.description: Casts rays against the loaded geometry: one from origin along direction (or towards a point), or up to 512 at once (rays). Returns the hit point, distance, object and the surface normal (which way a wall or floor faces). The user sees each ray shot and landing in the 3D view.

origin.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

direction.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

towards.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

rays.description: Several rays in one call (each: origin, direction or towards, max_distance)

origin.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

direction.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

towards.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

normal.description: Estimate the surface normal (default: one ray yes, batches of more than 16 no)

show.description: Animate the rays in the user's view (default true)

tools.name: ground_height
tools.title: Ground height
tools.description: Height of the first surface below points ([x, y, z] probes from 2 m above z; [x, y] from high above), or over a grid {min:[x,y], max:[x,y], step} (at most 2,500 samples) to read the terrain before building. The user sees the probes drop onto the ground.

tools.name: measure
tools.title: Measure
tools.description: Measures in the world and draws the measure in the user's view (the line traces itself, graduated, with its lengths). Either points (a polyline: each segment, the total; closed:true adds the perimeter and the floor area), or from and to, each a point [x, y, z] ([x, y]: on the ground there) or an object id: distance, horizontal distance, height difference, heading, slope; between objects also the gap between their boxes (clearance per axis, closest points, overlapping).

items.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

from.description: A point [x, y, z] or an object id

anyOf.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

to.description: A point [x, y, z] or an object id

anyOf.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

duration.description: Seconds it stays drawn (default 20, 0 = until annotate clear)

tools.name: measure_space
tools.title: Measure the space around a point
tools.description: Casts rays all around a point (directions, default 16), up and down: distance to the walls in each heading, floor and ceiling heights, clear height, widths east-west and north-south, the narrowest width, and headings that hit nothing (doorways, open air). Use it inside a room or a street before building. The user sees the rays burst out and the free space outlined.

position.description: [x, y, z], or [x, y]: height metres above the ground there

height.description: With [x, y]: metres above the ground (default 1.2)

annotations.title: Measure the space around a point

tools.name: annotate
tools.title: Draw in the user's view
tools.description: Draws marks in Studio's 3D view to show the user what you mean or plan, without changing the world (they are not exported): point (a pin with text), label, arrow (from, to), line (points, closed), measure (points, with lengths), box (min/max or center/size), sphere (center, radius), objects (ids: their boxes). color: cyan, violet, amber, green, red, white, #RRGGBB or [r,g,b]. duration seconds (default 30; 0 = until clear). clear:true removes your earlier marks first.

position.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

from.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

to.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

items.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

min.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

max.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

center.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

size.description: Uniform factor or [x, y, z] factors

tools.name: narrate
tools.title: Tell the user what you do
tools.description: Shows a message to the user in a feed at the left of Studio's 3D view: they watch you work there and cannot answer in it (they answer in your chat). Post what you are about to do (kind plan, with its steps), what you are doing (doing), what you finished (done), and notes (info), warnings, problems (error) or questions for the user. Each message slides in and types itself out; the running one pulses. Returns the message id: update that message (id with done_steps to tick a plan's steps as you go, status done or failed, or new text) rather than posting many. One or two sentences per message, in the user's language; clear:true removes the earlier messages.

steps.description: plan: the steps (12 at most), ticked later with done_steps

id.description: Update this earlier message instead of posting a new one

done_steps.description: Indexes (from 0) of the plan's steps now done

status.description: done settles a plan (every step ticked) or turns a doing message into done; failed marks it as a problem

annotations.title: Tell the user what you do

tools.name: lock_view
tools.title: Take or give back the view
tools.description: locked:true takes Studio's 3D view for yourself while you work through a sequence (camera moves, screenshots, measures): the user's mouse and keys no longer move the camera or pick in the view, its edges glow and breathe, and a pill says what you are doing (reason). The user keeps a Take back control button (and Esc). locked:false gives it back: do it as soon as you are done or need the user. It is released by itself after 5 minutes without a command. If the reply says the user took the view back (user_took_back), ask before taking it again.

locked.description: true takes the view (default), false gives it back

reason.description: What you are doing, shown to the user (e.g. Furnishing the kitchen)

annotations.title: Take or give back the view

tools.name: query_objects
tools.title: Find objects
tools.description: Objects (game and project) inside a sphere (center + radius) or a box (min/max), nearest first, with kind, asset, position, rotation, scale, size and whether they can be edited. Filter by kinds, text and source.

center.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

min.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

max.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

text.description: Words that must appear in the name or asset path

show.description: Animate the search in the user's view (default true)

tools.name: get_objects
tools.title: Object details
tools.description: Full details of objects: element properties, collision shapes, occlusion, links (collision and occluders that follow a mesh).

tools.name: select_objects
tools.title: Select objects
tools.description: Selects objects in Studio (to show the user) and optionally frames them.

tools.name: view_settings
tools.title: View settings
tools.description: Changes what the 3D view shows: layer scene/collision/occlusion (wireframes of collision or occluders), shading, night lighting preview, distant city, icons.

tools.name: bookmarks
tools.title: Bookmarks
tools.description: The user's saved camera views (name, position, heading, pitch).

tools.name: search_assets
tools.title: Search assets
tools.description: Searches the game's assets: meshes (props, architecture modules), entity templates (.ent: doors, devices…), particles, effects, decal materials. All words must match the name or folder. favorites:true limits to the user's library.

category.description: Decoration, Furniture, Architecture, Devices, Doors, Vegetation, Vehicles, Characters, Weapons and items, Effects, Environment, Quests, Other

tools.name: browse_assets
tools.title: Browse asset folders
tools.description: Lists the subfolders and files of an archive folder (e.g. base\environment\architecture\watson\).

tools.name: asset_info
tools.title: Asset sizes
tools.description: Box (min, max, size, center relative to the pivot at yaw 0), appearances, default look, parts and triangles of meshes and entity templates. Measure modules before tiling them.

tools.name: preview_asset
tools.title: Preview an asset
tools.description: Renders one mesh or entity template on its own (with its approximate colours) and returns the image.

tools.name: list_sounds
tools.title: Sound emitters
tools.description: Sound emitters loaded around the camera, by name: add_elements kind sound copies one of them.

tools.name: place_objects
tools.title: Place objects
tools.description: Adds meshes and entity templates (one undo step), optionally with elements (lights…) and collisions in the same step. Per item: ground snapping, a fitted collision box, appearance, door behaviour. Returns the new ids.

asset.description: Mesh (.mesh) or entity template (.ent) path from search_assets

position.description: [x, y, z] metres; [x, y] drops it onto the first surface from above

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees. yaw turns about +Z (counter-clockwise from above, 0 faces +Y); pitch about X; roll about Y.

scale.description: Uniform factor or [x, y, z] factors

ground.description: bottom: rest the asset's box on the surface below; pivot: put its pivot there

collision.description: box: add a fitted collision box that follows the mesh (meshes have no game collision otherwise)

door.description: Door behaviour for door templates (see add_elements)

elements.description: Lights and other elements added in the same step: same items as add_elements

collisions.description: Collisions added in the same step: same items as add_collision

tools.name: place_pattern
tools.title: Place a pattern
tools.description: Places one or more assets in a pattern (one undo step): grid (rows × columns), line (from → to), circle/arc, scatter (random in a disc or box, min_distance apart) or path (along points). Spacing defaults to the asset's footprint + gap; items can follow the line or face the center. assets are cycled (or picked at random with choose:"random").

origin.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

centered.description: grid: origin is the grid centre (default true)

from.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

to.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

follow.description: line/path: turn items along the line (default true)

center.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

min.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

max.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

dry_run.description: Return the computed items without placing them

tools.name: build_room
tools.title: Build a room
tools.description: Builds a rectangular room in one undo step: floor tiles, wall modules (stacked to the height, stretched to fit, with door openings), an optional ceiling, ceiling lights and collision (floor, walls, ceiling). Modules are measured with asset_info first. flip_walls turns wall modules around when their good side faces out. dry_run returns the plan.

center.description: [x, y, z] middle of the room at floor level

heading.description: Room rotation; local +Y is the north wall

stretch.description: Scale modules to fit exactly (default true)

offset.description: From the wall's middle along it, metres

asset.description: Optional door template (.ent) placed in the opening

lights.description: Number of ceiling lights (default one per 16 m², 0 for none)

collision.description: Floor, wall and ceiling collision boxes (default true)

tools.name: add_elements
tools.title: Add lights and elements
tools.description: Adds lights, particles, effects, decals, sound emitters, occluders, doors or entities (one undo step).

position.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees. yaw turns about +Z (counter-clockwise from above, 0 faces +Y); pitch about X; roll about Y.

scale.description: Uniform factor or [x, y, z] factors

color.description: [r, g, b] 0..1 (lights without temperature, decal tint)

sound.description: sound: name of a loaded game emitter to copy (list_sounds). customsound: id or name of a sound of the custom sound library (custom_sounds)

min_distance.description: customsound: full volume within (m); radius = silent beyond

playback.description: customsound: in a loop, or again after a random pause

pause.description: customsound interval: [shortest, longest] seconds of silence between plays

synced.description: customsound loop played by the server, the same moment for every player (16 at most per world)

plane.description: Occluder: a plane instead of a box

tools.name: edit_element
tools.title: Edit an element
tools.description: Changes the properties of a light, effect, decal, sound, occluder, door or entity (project or game; a game one becomes a project copy that replaces it). Same property names as add_elements.

properties.description: Properties to change, with the same keys as add_elements items (temperature, color, intensity, radius, resource, appearance, occluder_type, autohide, door…)

tools.name: transform_objects
tools.title: Move, turn, scale
tools.description: Moves, turns or scales objects (one undo step). Either items [{id, position | offset, rotation | rotate_yaw, scale}] or ids with a group offset, rotate_yaw about a pivot (default: their centre) and scale_factor. snap_to_ground rests them on the surface below. Game collision and occluders at a moved mesh follow it.

position.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

offset.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees. yaw turns about +Z (counter-clockwise from above, 0 faces +Y); pitch about X; roll about Y.

scale.description: Uniform factor or [x, y, z] factors

offset.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

pivot.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

tools.name: duplicate_objects
tools.title: Duplicate
tools.description: Copies objects (game or project) as new project objects, optionally offset.

offset.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

tools.name: delete_objects
tools.title: Delete
tools.description: Deletes objects (one undo step): project objects are removed, game objects are hidden by the exported mod. The collision and occluders placed exactly at a deleted mesh go with it.

tools.name: clear_area
tools.title: Clear an area
tools.description: Deletes every editable object in a sphere or box matching the filters (one undo step). Use dry_run:true first to see what would go. Remember occluders when you remove buildings.

center.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

min.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

max.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

text.description: Words that must appear in the name or asset path

show.description: Animate the search in the user's view (default true)

tools.name: add_collision
tools.title: Add collision
tools.description: Adds collision (boxes, spheres, capsules) in one undo step; attach_to makes it follow an object.

position.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees. yaw turns about +Z (counter-clockwise from above, 0 faces +Y); pitch about X; roll about Y.

scale.description: Uniform factor or [x, y, z] factors

attach_to.description: Object id this collision follows (moved and deleted with it)

preset.description: World Static (default, blocks everything), Player Blocker, Block Player and Vehicles, Vehicle Blocker, Simple Environment Collision, Complex Environment Collision, World Dynamic, Destructible, Shooting, Debris

size.description: Box: full size [x, y, z] in metres

length.description: Capsule: length of its straight part

offset.description: Shape position relative to the collision, metres

tools.name: fit_collision
tools.title: Fit collision boxes
tools.description: Adds a collision box fitted to each mesh (it follows the mesh).

tools.name: edit_collision
tools.title: Edit a project collision
tools.description: Replaces the shapes, preset, material, name or attachment of a project collision.

size.description: Box: full size [x, y, z] in metres

length.description: Capsule: length of its straight part

offset.description: Shape position relative to the collision, metres

tools.name: game_collision
tools.title: Edit game collision
tools.description: Game collision actors (query_objects kinds collision): switch one shape off or back on (e.g. an invisible wall left in a doorway), or make an editable project copy that replaces it. Moving and deleting use transform_objects / delete_objects.

tools.name: set_mesh_occlusion
tools.title: Mesh occlusion
tools.description: Sets how a mesh occludes what is behind it (type Default/None/Detail/MinorInterior/MajorInterior/Exterior, autohide 0–255). A game mesh becomes a project copy of its node that keeps its collision.

tools.name: expand_instanced_occluder
tools.title: Split an instanced occluder
tools.description: Turns an instanced occluder node (several boxes, kind occluder_instanced) into individual occluders you can move, retype or delete one by one.

tools.name: road_types
tools.title: Road types
tools.description: Road pieces the game can bend along a road (exportable ones by default), by name.

tools.name: create_road
tools.title: Create a road
tools.description: Creates a road through game-space points with a road type (road_types), optional banking (degrees) and ground snapping.

items.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

tools.name: edit_road
tools.title: Edit a road
tools.description: Changes a project road: points, type, banking, name, or action reverse / snap_to_ground / delete.

items.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

tools.name: list_roads
tools.title: Project roads
tools.description: The project's roads with their points.

tools.name: rebuild_game_road
tools.title: Edit a game road
tools.description: Turns a game road piece (kind road_piece) and the pieces continuing it into one editable project road that replaces them.

tools.name: elevator_types
tools.title: Elevator types
tools.description: The elevator types (cabin templates: common, with many looks; industrial; megabuilding) with their footprints; with type, that type's looks (appearances).

tools.name: create_elevator
tools.title: Create an elevator
tools.description: Creates a working elevator: the cabin, a call panel and a landing door on every floor, floor markers and invisible shaft walls. position: the cabin floor on the lowest floor (ground:true snaps it to the surface); floors: heights above it (2.5 m apart at least) or {height, name, door}; yaw: the side its doors open (default: towards the camera, 0 = -Y).

position.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

tools.name: edit_elevator
tools.title: Edit an elevator
tools.description: Changes a project elevator: floors (a new list), add_floors_at (world heights: a floor at each), floor {index, height, name, door}, remove_floor (index), type, appearance, yaw, position, name, speed, start_floor, panel_on_left, shaft, or action snap_to_ground / duplicate / delete.

position.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

tools.name: list_elevators
tools.title: Project elevators
tools.description: The project's elevators: type, look, base position, the side their doors face, and every floor (height above the base, world z, name, landing door).

tools.name: prefab_save
tools.title: Save a prefab
tools.description: Saves objects (meshes, elements, entities, collisions) relative to a pivot (default: their footprint centre at the lowest point) as a named prefab, reusable in any project and session.

pivot.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

tools.name: prefab_place
tools.title: Place a prefab
tools.description: Places a saved prefab at a position with a yaw (one undo step); ground:true puts its pivot on the surface below.

position.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees. yaw turns about +Z (counter-clockwise from above, 0 faces +Y); pitch about X; roll about Y.

tools.name: prefab_list
tools.title: List prefabs
tools.description: Saved prefabs with their descriptions and contents.

tools.name: prefab_delete
tools.title: Delete a prefab
tools.description: Deletes a saved prefab file.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undoes the last edits (each tool call that changed the world is one step).

tools.name: redo
tools.title: Redo
tools.description: Redoes undone edits.

tools.name: project
tools.title: Project
tools.description: summary: what the project changed (counts, added objects, elements, collisions, roads); new: a new empty project (name); open / save: a .ncwe file (path; save without path saves in place); rename; validate: check against the installed game.

tools.name: organize
tools.title: Organize the project (outliner)
tools.description: The outliner of the user's project: folders (nested, named, coloured) holding the project's objects (added meshes, elements, collision, roads, edited game objects). list: folders and objects; new_folder: name, folder (parent), ids (objects and folders to move in), color; move: ids into folder (empty: top level), before (an object id of that folder); rename: one id (object or folder), name; color: ids, color (#RRGGBB, absent clears); delete_folder: one folder id (with_contents also deletes its objects); active: folder new objects go into. A folder can be given by id (f:…) or path ("Apartment/Kitchen"). Organise what you build: one folder per room or area, colours by purpose.

color.description: #RRGGBB, e.g. #E05D5D red, #E8934A orange, #D9C24A yellow, #6DBA6A green, #4FB8B0 teal, #4F8FE0 blue, #9C7BE0 violet, #DE6FB4 pink

tools.name: import_model
tools.title: Import a 3D model
tools.description: Imports a model file into the user's custom mesh library (FBX, glTF, GLB, OBJ, DAE, 3DS..., or a zip holding one): geometry, materials and textures. Rigged models keep the pose of the file. Give height (metres) to set its real size, or scale; up_axis Y or Z (FBX/glTF: Y). analyze_only reports what would be imported (size, materials, missing textures) without importing. The reply's mesh.asset is placed with place_objects like any prop; exports include its game files.

path.description: Absolute path of the model or zip

height.description: Wanted height in metres (sets the scale)

scale.description: File units to metres (FBX in cm: 0.01)

tools.name: custom_meshes
tools.title: Custom mesh library
tools.description: The user's custom meshes (imported models): list them (id, asset path, size, materials), set a material (index or material name; base_color [r,g,b,a] 0-1, roughness, metalness, normal_strength, emissive_color, emissive_ev (0 = no glow, 4-8 glowing), alpha_cutout, double_sided, kind Standard/Glass/Game, game_material (a .mi/.mt path of the game), textures: base_color_texture, roughness_texture, metalness_texture, normal_texture, emissive_texture as absolute image paths), reimport (another height/scale/up_axis/pivot/yaw: placed copies follow), rename, delete.

tools.name: custom_sounds
tools.title: Custom sound library
tools.description: The user's own sounds, played by Open77 only (an Open77 export writes them into its resource; ArchiveXL mods cannot carry new sounds). import: an audio file (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A, WMA; converted when Open77 cannot play it as is: 16 MiB, 10 minutes at most). list, rename, delete. Place one with add_elements: kind customsound, sound = its id, radius = reach in metres, min_distance, volume, playback loop/interval, synced.

path.description: import: absolute path of the audio file

tools.name: traffic
tools.title: Traffic paths
tools.description: The lanes vehicles and pedestrians follow (the game's ~34,000 lanes are keyed g:<index>, lanes drawn in the project t:<id>; game space, points in the direction of travel). query: lanes near center [x,y,z] within radius (kind Road, Pavement, Intersection, Highway, Crosswalk). lane: one lane's points and links. edit: key with points, width (m), speed (m/s: 10 ≈ 36 km/h, 15 ≈ 54, pavements 1), flags (names: Road, Pavement, Intersection, Highway, CrossWalk, Bidirectional, TrafficDisabled, NoAIDriving, NoAutodrive, GPSOnly, Yield, Blockade, PatrolRoute, NeverDeadEnd, FromRoadSpline); both_ways (default true) keeps the reverse lane in step. link / unlink: from and to keys (entry: metres along `to` where it joins mid-way). delete: a game lane is disabled and unlinked, a drawn one removed (both_ways for the reverse too). revert: back to the game's lane. create: points, kind road|intersection|highway|pavement|crosswalk, width, speed, both_ways (two lanes), auto_connect (default true: its ends link to the lanes they meet). along_road: lanes along an editor road (road id from list_roads; forward and backward lane counts, width, speed; driving on the right), linked at its ends. show: the overlay on/off and its range. Exports (ArchiveXL, Open77) replace the game's traffic files with these lanes.

center.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

items.description: [x, y, z] in metres, game space (Z up)

tools.name: export_mod
tools.title: Export the mod
tools.description: Exports the project: archivexl (an ArchiveXL mod: copy its archive\pc\mod into the game), open77 (an Open77 world resource folder) or worldbuilder (entSpawner JSON, added meshes only).

tools.name: studio_command
tools.title: Raw Studio command
tools.description: Advanced: sends one command to Studio's automation pipe as is (op plus arguments) and returns its reply. Prefer the dedicated tools.
